CustomField.description: Fundraising Quick Start: short, URL-safe identifier for use in UTM campaign codes and Outreach Summary source tracking. Lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens recommended (e.g. fy26-yearend-email).
CustomField.label: Short Name
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Equivalent to utm_campaign in web analytics. Used as the campaign segment when naming Outreach Source Codes (e.g. Short Name "fy26-yearend" → source code "EM-FY26-YEAREND-01"). Also use this value directly as utm_campaign on any URLs promoted by this campaign. Lowercase, alphanumeric and hyphens only — no spaces.
